paragraphs.text: Strixhaven is a school of magic located on the Orrithia continent of the plane Arcavios . The Echoverse version of the school is Hexhaven .

At the birth of the plane , as the mana of two planes overlapped in conflicting ways, many forms of life adapted to the new structure, and many new forms of life were spawned. Five particularly powerful snarls of overlapping mana became luminous spheres, from which were hatched five dragons . The five elder dragons of Arcavios were born from these snarls, and millennia later, they founded Strixhaven University at the epicenter of the snarls. These dragons have become emblems of the magic of the plane, living symbols of the clashing forces of the five dichotomies.

The Founder Dragons were the first to master the magic of the five enemy color combinations. When the humanoid races arose, at first the dragons were angered that mortals would try to harness the wild forces of magic, but they came to realize that only through disciplined study would magic be in safe hands. So, around 3861 AR , Prismari had the idea for the dragons to found an institution devoted to the study of the five mana dichotomies, and that institution is now known as Strixhaven . The five colleges were based around the magic mastered by each of those dragons. To this day, the Founder Dragons roam the plane, the five deadly sages of the skies. They no longer associate directly with Strixhaven, preferring to let the deans of the college speak in their stead. The dragons' wisdom is vast, but their tempers can be short. Mages seek them out only to learn the most elusive of secrets.

Founded around 3861 AR by five elder dragons , Strixhaven University is Arcavios's premier institution of magical learning, drawing promising young mages from all around the plane to study in its halls. Strixhaven is divided into five colleges, each with its own campus, faculty, and magical specialties. The mission of Strixhaven University is to discover and preserve magical knowledge, disseminate that knowledge from one generation to the next, promote the free and open study of magic in all its forms, and enhance the lives of people throughout the plane through the use of magic.

After the opening of the Omenpaths in 4562 AR , the inaugural class of off-plane students was welcomed the following year, alongside new professors from a number of the Multiverse's most prestigious institutions. As its reputation has grown, the university has generated an unofficial rivalry with the Tolarian Academies and Prism University . To protect against exoplanar threats, the university established the Path Ward, a committee to oversee the Omenpaths. The committee approves any travel through the Omenpaths and vets any visitors that come through to ensure they are not a threat to the university or the plane at large. Pathwarden mages are charged with discovering and observing paths, escorting new arrivals, and preventing citizens from wandering onto other planes. Preservationists believe beings should remain on their home plane.

The school is the most elite university in the Multiverse . Because of this, there are several planeswalkers who secretly have enrolled as students. Strixhaven features five Colleges, which battle it out with their takes on magic. Each college is named after an elder dragon who founded it and is associated with two enemy colors . The Five Colleges are:
Lorehold ( ) — Passionate scholars and explorers who dedicate their studies to adventure and discovery. Their motto is "Leave no stone unturned."
Prismari ( ) — Mages who focus on the artistic side, using the elements to express themselves and their emotions. Their motto is "Express yourself with the elements."
Quandrix ( ) — They are mathematician wizards, seeing math and magic as the same concept. Their motto is "Math is magic."
Silverquill ( ) — They specialize in verbal magic, ranging from empowering poetry to biting arcane insults. Their motto is "Sharp style. Sharper wit."
Witherbloom ( ) — They are nature mages, on both sides of the spectrum, either empowering nature or exploiting it. Their motto is "Get your hands dirty."
Each College features its faculty, campus, magical specialties, identity, logo, and mascots.

Scholarships are available to eligible students, as well as the option to pay off any remaining tuition fees by working with research teams. Students pick their preferred College in their second year.
Automated Campus Guides help students find their destinations, while Skycoaches provide transportation over longer distances.

The attendees of Strixhaven are known generally as mage-students . New students are called first-years until they choose one of Strixhaven's five colleges of study. All first-years wear a standardized university uniform that is distinct from the look of any of the colleges. Generally, after a student's first year of basic curriculum (hence the name), they choose one of the five mystic colleges. Thereafter, they dress according to their chosen college. Students are given a stipend and allowed to set their own pace for completing requirements. Students carry styluses, tools used to channel their magic.

Once a mage has chosen a college, they are assigned two counselors, one from each of the two mana colors of the college. The two counselors often give conflicting advice about the student's best path through the university. Eventually, the mage chooses their concentration (represented by their color identity). The mage's concentration is usually one of their college's two mana colors, but sometimes, it's a blend of both.

Professors of Strixhaven are mages advanced in their chosen magical field who have devoted their lives to teaching other mages. There are several ranks of professors according to seniority, the distinction of magical research, and knowledge of spells.
Instructor – A mage who teaches classes and their curriculum but who has not yet passed a provisionary period of observation and evaluation to become a full professor.
Professor – An established, accredited educator devoted to a field of magical study. Most of the educators at Strixhaven have the professor rank.

Esteemed Professor – A professor who has distinguished themselves in their career, usually through published and peer-reviewed magical research or other specialized studies. Most esteemed professors have taught at Strixhaven for over twenty years.

Dean – Each college has two deans who each head up one half of that college. Each dean is a powerful mage and distinguished professor who's aligned with one of the two mana colors of that college. The ten deans are like contradictory advisors to the entirety of their college; they have deep professional rivalries with each other and always disagree with each other about the best path for studying magic.
Mage Emeritus – A professor who no longer holds a position at Strixhaven is often called a mage emeritus. Mages emeriti are frequently held in high esteem as guest lecturers and speakers.

There is an intense rivalry between the Colleges, and they battle that out in magical duels. It is part of Strixhaven's special sport called Mage Tower . The rules are simple: two opposing teams meet in the school's large stadium alongside their mascots. There are three phases of play. Each mascot sits on a tower, and the goal is to steal the opposing team's mascot and transport it over to their side. The use of all magic is legal, except that which would physically harm opponents, mascots, or somebody in the stands, or damage the stadium. Each phase lasts twenty minutes, and then a winner is declared.

Graduates from Strixhaven travel many different paths after leaving the university. Many simply return to their communities, using their magic to help at home. Some mages travel the plane in search of ever-greater magic, engaging in mage duels when they encounter others along their path. Some find a new home with a loved one or with their mystical pastimes. Some create sanctums or laboratories to continue their study, perhaps even hoping to one day return to Strixhaven as professors themselves. A select few join the Dragonsguard , an elite force of mages who work with the honored Founder Dragons .
The campus stretches across the horizon, an intricate tangle of gleaming towers and flattened rooftops.

Central Campus is the bustling academic and administrative core of Strixhaven, where students from all five colleges gather for shared learning and social life. Anchored by the massive Biblioplex and crowned by the Dawnbow, this sprawling nexus of magical towers, open plazas, and interwoven pathways embodies the university’s mission to unite diverse disciplines through scholarship and discovery.

Lorehold Campus - a dramatic blend of ancient architecture and magical reconstruction, featuring grand lecture halls, towering effigies, and cliffside structures carved directly into sheer rock faces. Streets are lined with monuments to historical figures, and a precarious network of historical buildings is connected by narrow bridges suspended over dizzying heights.

Prismari Campus – a dazzling and kinetic environment where natural elements and magical constructs swirl together in vibrant, ever-shifting displays. Towering spires of crystallized energy, molten sculptures, and floating platforms form a landscape shaped by creative impulse and elemental power.

Quandrix Campus – an impossibly ordered yet organic setting where spiraling streams, fractal gardens, and gravity-defying structures echo the mathematical beauty of nature. The campus is alive with motion and symmetry, blending theoretical abstraction with verdant growth and geomantic precision.

Silverquill Campus – a refined and imposing domain of marble halls, vaulted lecture theaters, and shadow-laced courtyards etched with glowing script. The interplay of light and darkness saturates the space with rhetorical energy, where every word spoken feels like a performance etched into the air itself.

Witherbloom Campus - a shadowy expanse of tangled swamp and living bog, where thick mist clings to vine-choked walkways and the air hums with the essence of decay and growth. Twisting wooden structures rise organically from the marsh, blurring the line between architecture and nature, as students study life and death amid the bubbling pools and bioluminescent undergrowth.
Some locations are not on a known campus:

The Void - An area enchanted with a modified spell of silence; those inside can't be heard by those outside. Created accidentally during a duel, it has become a popular spot for students to blow off steam.

Dead Languages Society Members: Drazhomir Yarnask , Quentillius A. Melentor III Devotees of ancient tongues, these scholars take full advantage of Strixhaven University's vast collection of tomes in long-forgotten or nearly extinct languages. They teach themselves these dialects and often translate their favorite works for fellow members.

Distinguished Society of Fine Artists Members: Cadoras Damellawar , Nora Ann Wu A collective of painters, sculptors, printmakers, and mosaicists who gather to create art and discuss the latest trends, techniques, and theories in the fine arts.

Dragonchess Club Members: Bhedum Sooviij , Tilana Kapule Enthusiasts of the strategic game of dragonchess, these players debate tactics, test one another’s skills, and experiment with homebrew variations of the game’s rules.

Dragonsguard Historical Society Member: Bhedum Sooviij Historians fascinated by every era meet to discuss, debate, and explore in detail their favorite historical topics, often drawing on the traditions of the Dragonsguard .

Fantastical Floriculture Club Member: Urzmaktok Grojsh Green-thumbed magicians blend botanical skill with arcane talent to create new plant varieties, many of which are grown in special plots on the Strixhaven University campus.

Future Entrepreneurs of Strixhaven Member: Grayson Wildemere Aspiring business minds meet to exchange theories, develop ventures, and launch student-run enterprises. Proceeds from these projects support the club’s ongoing activities.
Intramural Gymnastics Club Member: Zanther Bowen Athletes in this club refine their gymnastic abilities and compete against each other in elaborate, high-energy floor routines.
Intramural Mage Tower Captain: Aziza

Intramural Silkball Club Members: Javenesh Stoutclaw , Melwythorne , Tilana Kapule This team trains for and competes in the rough, muddy sport of silkball, a campus favorite played with spider-silk balls on slippery fields.
Intramural Water-Dancing Club Member: Larine Arneza Merging swimming with artistry, members choreograph water dances set to popular music, performing intricate routines with synchronized grace.

Live-Action Roleplaying Guild Members: Cadoras Damellawar , Rosimyffenbip Wuzfeddlims Combining storytelling, strategy, and playacting—often with the inclusion of mascots—this guild stages elaborate fantasy scenarios resolved through special rule systems.
Mage Tower Cheer Squad Member: Zanther Bowen With coordinated cheers, outfits, and school spirit, these cheerleaders rally the crowd and inspire the Strixhaven University Mage Tower teams to victory.

Orchestra of the Arcane Grand Maestro: Zaffai An exclusive group composed of the most talented Prismari students. This ensemble rehearses exclusively outdoors to safely accommodate their performances, which light up the skies with elemental magic during their concerts. Zaffai serves as the Orchestra's Grand Maestro, a prestigious position.
Outdoor Urbanists Leader: Emil A group that specializes in venturing beyond campus and observes and measures the natural world to develop formulas that will create more perfect environments.

Playactors Drama Guild Members: Quentillius A. Melentor III , Rubina Larkingdale This theatrical troupe produces innovative performances that reimagine classic plays, often incorporating magic, music, and dazzling special effects.
Prismari Players Theatre group, including stage productions and dance.
Strixhaven Iron-Lifters Society Member: Greta Gorunn A community of student bodybuilders who train together, supporting one another in building both physical strength and lasting camaraderie.

Strixhaven Show Band Association Members: Aurora Luna Wynterstarr , Rubina Larkingdale Musicians in this association perform with instruments from hurdy-gurdies to bagpipes, staging lively concerts for the Strixhaven University community.

Strixhaven Star Members: Grayson Wildemere , Mina Lee The student reporters and editors behind the Strixhaven Star interview prominent campus figures, investigate events, and publish the university’s monthly newspaper.
Student-Mages of Faith Members: Melwythorne , Shuvadri Glintmantle Students from diverse religious backgrounds come together to share prayers, debate theology, and celebrate each other’s holy days.
Witherbloom Foraging Collective A plant gathering and identification club.

The name Strixhaven is a combination of "Strix" and "haven". Strixes are magical birds from the mythology of classical antiquity, closely associated with witches . Strix is also a genus of owls. The association is reinforced by Strixhaven's symbol, an owl, and the Aven race of Arcavios, the owlin .
